title: dup shares the position, open does not
summary: Two descriptors made with dup share one file position; two made with open each have their own.
hints: After `fd2 = dup(fd1)` both numbers refer to the same open file, so a `read` on one moves the position seen by the other.
Each `open` of the same path creates a new open file with its own position, starting at 0. `read` does not add a `'\0'`: do it yourself before printing.
